description: HISVIA Premium Asset Role Schema — mapping visual roles to UI components and quality thresholds

hero_machine_macro.description: Extreme close-up of industrial machinery — gears, cutting tools, precision parts. Strong depth of field, dramatic lighting.

product_detail.description: Finished precision component on neutral/dark background. CNC-machined metal parts with visible surface finish.

factory_action.description: Dynamic factory scene with action — CNC cutting, welding sparks, assembly line movement, robot arm operation.

inspection_scene.description: Quality engineer performing inspection — CMM measurement, caliper check, surface testing. Candid, professional.

supplier_profile.description: Factory workshop overview showing scale and organization. Clean, well-lit manufacturing floor.

material_showcase.description: Material samples or raw material stock. Metal sheets, aluminum blocks, steel rods.

process_shot.description: Manufacturing process in action — molten metal pouring, injection mold closing, laser cutting beam.

facility_aerial.description: Aerial or wide shot of factory facility showing scale. Not hero material — supporting visual only.

certification_badge.description: Certification logos and badges — ISO, CE, API, ASME. Vector or clean photography.

trust_evidence.description: Evidence of verification — audit photo, inspection report, quality certificate.

fallback_strategy.description: When no asset meets the minimum premium score for a role, use a smaller visual treatment or abstract industrial graphic. Never lower the quality threshold.

strategies.no_hero_asset: Use abstract gradient + icon instead of photo. Show smaller visual with more surrounding whitespace.
strategies.no_product_asset: Use silhouette or line-art illustration of part. Avoid placeholder stock photos.
strategies.no_factory_asset: Use data visualization (metrics, charts) as primary visual. Factory photo becomes secondary.
